title: solver doesn't find correct version of package with a number at the end of the name

## Issue
<!-- Now feel free to write your issue, and please be as descriptive as possible! Make sure to include detailed reproduction steps. -->
<!-- Thanks again 🙌 ❤ -->

```

```

```
$ poetry add flask-restful-swagger-2@0.35
Could not find a matching version of package flask-restful-swagger-2
```
